PLAN "Climb-Ready Upper Focus (Pain-Free ROM)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve upper-body strength and climbing-specific control while respecting pain-free range and no overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Intro & Scapular Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Scapula & Horizontal Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Rotator Health & Core":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          external_rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          prone_T 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull Emphasis - Pain-Free":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Scapula & Horizontal Push/Pull":
        warmup:
